tldr: 台股週五重挫 1,195.97 點（2.67%）收 43,654.84 點、失守 44,000 關卡，外資由買轉賣調節約 600 億元。
環球晶義大利 Novara 廠 8 吋產線因火災停產，矽晶圓類股走弱，惟 12 吋產線不受影響。
金管會核准玉山金併三商美邦人壽，合併基準日訂 9 月 1 日，延續壽險整併潮。
投資人續以 ETF 逢低布局，0050 六月定期定額扣款達 126 億元創高，抗震高股息 ETF 跌幅明顯低於大盤。
國際上，美股收震盪一週漲跌互見、那指週線收黑，費半重挫 4.25%，Alphabet 上修 AI 資本支出加深燒錢疑慮。
6 月 CPI 升至 17 個月新高 2.6%、續破 2% 警戒線，惟 AI 帶動出口強勁，台灣成長展望仍穩健。

items.title_zh: 外資變臉狂砍，台股重挫近 1,200 點
items.title_en: TAIEX tumbles nearly 1,200 points as foreign funds turn net sellers
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週五終場大跌 1,195.97 點、跌幅 2.67%，收 43,654.84 點，失守 44,000 點與季線，成交值約 7,940 億元。外資由買轉賣、單日調節約 600 億元，投信則逆勢連 23 個交易日買超力挺，試圖緩和賣壓，市場避險情緒明顯升溫。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index sank 1,195.97 points, or 2.67%, to close at 43,654.84 on Friday, breaking below the 44,000 level and its quarterly moving average on turnover of about NT$794bn. Foreign investors flipped from buyers to sellers, offloading roughly NT$60bn, while local investment trusts bought for a 23rd straight session in a bid to cushion the fall.

items.title_zh: 賣壓全面出籠，指數摜破關鍵技術支撐
items.title_en: Selling breadth widens as index loses key technical support
items.summary_zh: 週五盤面跌多漲少，下跌家數逾 1,200 家、為上漲家數兩倍以上，記憶體與矽晶圓族群跌勢居前，指數跌破季線。關鍵支撐失守加上外資轉空操作，使大盤在新的一週開盤前偏向防禦，短線多空氣氛轉趨保守。
items.summary_en: Declining issues overwhelmed advancers by more than two-to-one on Friday, with over 1,200 stocks lower and memory and silicon-wafer names among the hardest hit as the index slipped under its quarterly line. The break of key support levels, combined with the shift in foreign positioning, left the market on the defensive heading into the new week.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 環球晶義大利 Novara 廠 8 吋產線遭火吻停產
items.title_en: Fire halts GlobalWafers' 8-inch line at Italy's Novara plant
items.summary_zh: 環球晶（6488）公告義大利 Novara 廠無塵室機台起火，8 吋產線停止生產，無人員傷亡，損失與復工時程待評估。供應鏈估受影響產能約占集團全球 8 吋產能 5%，12 吋產線不受影響。公司將透過全球據點調度因應；消息帶動股價一度重挫逾 8%，中美晶、台勝科等同步走弱。
items.summary_en: GlobalWafers said a fire in a cleanroom tool knocked out the 8-inch wafer line at its Novara facility in Italy, with no casualties but production suspended pending damage assessment. Supply-chain estimates put the affected output at roughly 5% of the group's global 8-inch capacity; the 12-inch line was unaffected. Shares fell more than 8% and dragged peers Sino-American Silicon and Tainergy lower.

items.title_zh: AI 伺服器需求續強，撐起鴻海創高動能
items.title_en: AI-server demand keeps powering Foxconn's record run
items.summary_zh: 鴻海雲端網路產品受惠 AI 伺服器訂單暢旺，6 月營收 8,218 億元、年增 52%，第二季營收 2.51 兆元、年增 39.8%，同創同期新高。公司預期第三季 AI 機櫃需求延續成長、ICT 產品進入傳統旺季，營運可望季年雙增，顯示硬體供應鏈動能未因股市震盪而降溫。
items.summary_en: Foxconn's cloud-and-networking segment continues to ride surging AI-server orders, after the group posted June revenue of NT$821.8bn (up 52%) and second-quarter revenue of NT$2.51tn (up 39.8%), both same-period highs. Management expects AI chassis demand to keep growing into the third quarter as ICT products enter their seasonal peak, underscoring resilient hardware momentum despite equity-market volatility.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准玉山金併三商美邦人壽
items.title_en: FSC approves E.Sun Financial's acquisition of Sanshang Life
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意玉山金控以換股方式併購三商美邦人壽 100% 股權，合併基準日訂為 9 月 1 日。金管會認定本案符合金控法與保險法規定，兼顧保戶與員工權益、財務健全及經營能力等條件；換股比例為每 1 股三商壽換 0.2486 股玉山金，成為國內壽險整併再添一樁指標案例。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission cleared E.Sun Financial Holding's plan to acquire 100% of Sanshang American Bankers Life Insurance via a share swap, setting a September 1 merger base date. Regulators judged the deal met financial-holding and insurance-law requirements on policyholder protection, financial soundness and management capability. The share-swap ratio is 0.2486 E.Sun shares per Sanshang share.

items.title_zh: 壽險整併潮改寫產業版圖
items.title_en: Taiwan's life-insurance consolidation wave reshapes the sector
items.summary_zh: 除玉山金案外，壽險業 2026 年進入結構重整期，台新人壽將併入新光體系走入歷史，多家金控同步推進保險整併。此趨勢反映 IFRS 17 與新一代清償能力（ICS）資本規範壓力，促使體質較弱的壽險公司尋求強力母體，並牽動銀保與財富管理通路的競爭格局。
items.summary_en: Beyond the E.Sun deal, the industry is entering 2026 amid a broader restructuring, with Taishin Life set to disappear as it merges into the Shin Kong group and other holding companies pursuing insurance tie-ups. The trend reflects pressure from IFRS 17 and ICS capital rules, pushing smaller insurers to seek stronger parents and reshaping competition across bancassurance and wealth channels.

items.title_zh: ETF 逢低布局加溫，定期定額扣款創高
items.title_en: "Buy the dip" via ETFs intensifies as regular-savings inflows hit records
items.summary_zh: 投資人透過 ETF 定期定額愈跌愈買，0050 六月單月扣款達 126 億元、寫下新高，槓桿型元大台灣 50 正 2（00631L）在回檔時同樣熱門。以 7 月 13 至 16 日台股回檔為例，0050 與 00631L 淨申購分別約 186.5 億元、100.4 億元，顯示紀律型買盤在波動中穩住資金動能。
items.summary_en: Retail investors leaned into weakness through ETF regular-savings plans, with 0050 drawing a record NT$12.6bn of monthly deductions in June and leveraged 00631L also popular on pullbacks. During the July 13–16 correction, 0050 and 00631L saw net subscriptions of about NT$18.65bn and NT$10.04bn, underscoring how systematic buying is anchoring flows amid volatility.

items.title_zh: 抗震高股息 ETF 成資產防禦要角
items.title_en: Defensive high-dividend ETFs cushion portfolios in the selloff
items.summary_zh: 台股走弱之際，00713、00918、00939、00961 等抗震高股息 ETF 跌幅明顯低於大盤，吸引追求收益的投資人。FT 臺灣永續高息（00961）以近 18% 年化息率居 7 月配息之冠，另有多檔 ETF 排隊除息，凸顯在震盪盤勢中，收益型商品成為資產配置的避風港。
items.summary_en: As the market fell, "earthquake-resistant" high-dividend ETFs such as 00713, 00918, 00939 and 00961 posted noticeably smaller declines than the broad index, drawing yield-focused investors. FT Taiwan Sustainable High Dividend (00961) topped July payouts with an annualized yield near 18%, while a batch of ETFs lined up for July ex-dividend, reinforcing income strategies as a shelter during choppy conditions.

items.title_zh: 2026 遺產稅、贈與稅免稅額維持，級距隨物價調升
items.title_en: 2026 estate and gift-tax exemptions held; brackets nudged for inflation
items.summary_zh: 2026 年遺產稅與贈與稅免稅額維持不變，贈與稅每年免稅額仍為 244 萬元；課稅級距則因累積 CPI 達法定調整門檻而上調。會計師指出，免稅額持穩加上級距上移，替高資產家庭保留了今年微調傳承贈與與信託架構的空間，宜及早檢視名下資產配置與贈與節奏。
items.summary_en: For 2026 Taiwan keeps its estate-tax and gift-tax exemption thresholds unchanged, with the annual gift-tax allowance staying at NT$2.44m, while taxable brackets are adjusted upward after cumulative CPI met the statutory revision trigger. Advisers say the steady thresholds and higher bracket bands give high-net-worth families a window to fine-tune succession gifting and trust structures this year.
items.source_name: 自由電子報 地產天下

items.title_zh: 財政部收緊「死亡前二年贈與配偶財產」併計遺產
items.title_en: MOF tightens rule on spousal gifts made shortly before death
items.summary_zh: 財政部發布作業原則，明定被繼承人死亡前二年內贈與配偶之財產須併計遺產總額課徵遺產稅，並預告修正遺產及贈與稅法部分條文草案。此舉旨在防堵臨終前移轉稀釋遺產稅基，對規劃跨世代財富傳承的高資產家庭而言，合規要求趨嚴，贈與時點與標的安排須更謹慎。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has issued operating principles under which property gifted to a spouse within two years before the giver's death is added back into the taxable estate, and has flagged draft amendments to the estate and gift-tax act. The move aims to curb last-minute transfers that erode the estate-tax base, sharpening compliance requirements for affluent families planning intergenerational wealth transfers.

items.title_zh: 6 月 CPI 升至 2.6%、17 個月新高，7 月估仍破 2%
items.title_en: June CPI climbs to 2.6%, a 17-month high; July seen still above 2%
items.summary_zh: 台灣 6 月消費者物價指數年增 2.60%，為近 17 個月最大增幅，且連 2 個月突破 2% 通膨警戒線，主因油價與菜價走高。主計總處預估 7 月漲幅將因油價回落與端午效應消退而略降，惟通膨持續高於目標，增添央行在兼顧成長與物價穩定間拿捏政策的難度。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's consumer price index rose 2.60% year-on-year in June, its fastest in about 17 months and a second straight month above the 2% alert line, driven by oil and vegetable prices. The statistics agency expects July's increase to ease slightly as crude retreats and holiday effects fade, but persistent above-target inflation complicates the central bank's balancing act between growth and price stability.

items.title_zh: AI 帶動成長強勁，台灣景氣展望維持穩健
items.title_en: Robust AI-driven growth keeps Taiwan's outlook firm despite price pressure
items.summary_zh: 官方與智庫預測顯示台灣今年成長動能不弱，第一季 GDP 成長率約 14.55%，全年 2026 年成長率預估接近雙位數，受惠出口與投資同步走強。中華經濟研究院等機構預期景氣呈「前高後穩」格局；惟通膨貼近 2% 警戒線，使政策當局對任何寬鬆步調仍保持審慎。
items.summary_en: Official and think-tank projections point to another strong year, with first-quarter GDP growth reported around 14.55% and full-year 2026 growth forecast near double digits on booming exports and investment. The Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research and other bodies expect momentum to stay "front-loaded then steady," even as sticky inflation near the 2% line keeps policymakers cautious about the pace of any easing.

items.title_zh: 台媒：費半重挫 4.25%，科技股賣壓沉重
items.title_en: Taiwan media: Philly chip index dives 4.25% as tech names sell off
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，費城半導體指數週五重挫 4.25%，晶片股全面走弱：美光跌 6.99%、英特爾跌 7.89%、超微跌 3.29%、輝達跌 0.92%，台積電美國 ADR 跌 2.93%。賣壓源於市場憂心雲端巨頭 AI 資本支出過度膨脹，壓抑主導台灣出口的 AI 晶片供應鏈，也牽動隔日台股權值股表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese outlets reported that the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbled 4.25% on Friday, with heavy losses across chip names — Micron off 6.99%, Intel down 7.89%, AMD off 3.29%, Nvidia down 0.92% and TSMC's US-listed ADR off 2.93%. The rout was tied to worries over hyperscalers' ballooning AI capital spending, pressuring the AI-chip supply chain that dominates Taiwan's export economy.

items.title_zh: 分析：費半急殺背後是「財報踩雷」
items.title_en: Analysts flag "earnings landmines" behind the chip-sector plunge
items.summary_zh: 國內研究評論指出，半導體賣壓來自多檔科技股財報在毛利或支出指引上不如預期，引發資金轉趨防禦。策略分析師示警，AI 高估值使市場容錯空間有限，投資人重新評估龐大 AI 投資轉化為獲利的速度，硬體供應鏈短線恐續震盪，宜留意權值股評價與籌碼變化。
items.summary_en: Local research commentary noted that the semiconductor sell-off followed a string of tech earnings that disappointed on margins or spending guidance, prompting a defensive rotation. Strategists warned that lofty AI valuations leave little room for error, and that further volatility is likely as investors reassess how quickly heavy AI investment will translate into profits across the hardware chain.

items.title_zh: 美股收震盪一週漲跌互見，那指週線收黑（2026-07-24）
items.title_en: US stocks close a volatile week mixed as Nasdaq logs a weekly loss (2026-07-24)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五收盤分歧：道瓊上漲 235.60 點、漲幅 0.46% 收 51,947.25 點，標普 500 微漲 0.05% 收 7,411.98 點，那斯達克則跌 0.64% 收 24,975.82 點。三大指數週線同步收黑，以那指約 2% 跌幅最深，反映科技權值走弱與 AI 支出疑慮壓抑反彈力道，市場情緒偏向謹慎。
items.summary_en: Wall Street ended Friday split: the Dow rose 235.60 points, or 0.46%, to 51,947.25 and the S&P 500 edged up 0.05% to 7,411.98, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.64% to 24,975.82. All three indexes posted weekly declines, led by a roughly 2% drop for the Nasdaq, as megacap-tech weakness and AI-spending worries capped attempts to recover from midweek losses.

items.title_zh: Alphabet 上修資本支出，加深 AI 燒錢疑慮（2026-07-24）
items.title_en: Alphabet's raised capex guidance stokes AI-spending jitters (2026-07-24)
items.summary_zh: Alphabet 每股盈餘約 9.11 美元、營收約 1,036.2 億美元均優於預期，但因將 2026 年資本支出指引由 1,800–1,900 億美元上修至 1,950–2,050 億美元，股價反壓抑大盤。更龐大的 AI 建置計畫加深投資人對雲端巨頭自由現金流消耗的憂慮，也再度引發市場對 AI 熱潮支出可持續性的辯論。
items.summary_en: Alphabet beat estimates with EPS of about US$9.11 and revenue near US$103.62bn, but its shares weighed on the market after it lifted 2026 capital-expenditure guidance to US$195–205bn from US$180–190bn. The bigger AI build-out intensified investor concern over hyperscalers' free-cash-flow drain, feeding a broader debate about how much spending the AI boom can sustain before profits catch up.

items.title_zh: 晶片股續挫，SanDisk 重摔約 11%（2026-07-24）
items.title_en: Chip stocks slide further as SanDisk tumbles 11% (2026-07-24)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五道瓊收復部分失土，但科技股續跌，SanDisk 單日大跌約 11%，為表現最差個股之一。半導體與記憶體族群成為資金撤離高估值科技股的重災區，延續晶片股近期弱勢；投資人持續質疑 AI 相關資本支出的節奏與回報，避險情緒推升類股波動。
items.summary_en: The Dow clawed back ground on Friday even as technology stocks fell further, with SanDisk plunging about 11% among the day's worst performers. Semiconductor and memory names bore the brunt of a defensive rotation out of high-valuation tech, extending a bruising stretch for chip shares as investors questioned the pace and payoff of AI-related capital spending.

items.title_zh: 油價回落至 96 美元下方，美股因關稅分歧（2026-07-24）
items.title_en: Oil retreats below US$96 as US indexes diverge on tariffs (2026-07-24)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五走勢分歧，投資人一邊評估一套新的全球關稅措施，一邊消化 AI 疑慮與偏高的債券殖利率；油價同步回落，布蘭特原油期貨下跌約 4%、跌破每桶 96 美元。能源成本回檔略為緩和市場情緒，協助道瓊與標普 500 止穩，惟科技權重較高的指數表現仍相對疲弱。
items.summary_en: US stocks split on Friday as investors weighed a new set of global tariffs alongside AI jitters and elevated bond yields, while oil prices eased — Brent crude futures fell about 4% to trade below US$96 a barrel. The pullback in energy costs offered some relief to sentiment, helping the Dow and S&P 500 stabilize even as tech-heavy gauges struggled.
